chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever has good fiqh (comprehension/jurisprudential knowledge), for him is a good deed (or reward).
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for having good fiqh according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) links excellent *fiqh* directly to spiritual reward, emphasizing that deep jurisprudential understanding is not merely an intellectual exercise but a source of divine merit. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the Imamate and scholarly tradition, where the comprehension of divine law by the Ahl al-Bayt and their deputies is considered a continuous act of worship. The hadith underscores that true *fiqh* involves both theoretical knowledge and practical application, thereby elevating the scholar's status in the eyes of God.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-70 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
Whoever has a good ability to comprehend will attain the good.”
